name: deezspotag-metadata
author: madmetal7
description: Serves artist biographies and top songs from a DeezSpoTag instance. Intended for libraries that MusicBrainz and Last.fm do not cover.

http.reason: Reads artist biographies and top songs from the configured DeezSpoTag server.

cache.reason: Caches responses so repeated artist page views do not re-query DeezSpoTag.

baseUrl.title: DeezSpoTag base URL
baseUrl.description: Must be reachable from the Navidrome container.

apiToken.title: DeezSpoTag API token
apiToken.description: Matches ApiToken in DeezSpoTag settings, or the DEEZSPOTAG_API_TOKEN env var.

preferredBiographySource.title: Preferred biography source
preferredBiographySource.description: spotify, deezer, apple or lastfm. Falls back to any available source.
